settings.title: Automatic Spacer Bending Machine with Digital Meter

settings.text:
Producing standard double-glazed glass units to the highest quality requires advanced, purpose-built machinery. Equipment commonly used on a double-glazing production line includes a spacer bending machine, glass washing machine, gas filling machine, pressing table, cutting table, butyl applicator, sealant applicator, and more.
Here, we examine the spacer bending machine, explain how it works, and conclude by introducing a semi-automatic spacer bending machine with a digital meter.

settings.title: The Importance of a Glass Spacer Bending Machine
settings.text:
In a double-glazed window production line, spacer bars are used to create the gap between the panes of glass. Since window or door profiles are cut to precise dimensions according to the customer's requirements, the aluminium spacer must also be cut and bent with the same accuracy.
This means that the bent spacer must fit precisely into the corners of the window. If the cutting and bending dimensions do not match the profile dimensions, this can cause problems during window assembly and may also lead to gas leakage between the panes of a double-glazed window. As a result, the finished window will not perform as intended.
Using this machine, an average of up to 200 medium and large frames can also be produced during an eight-hour shift. Therefore, compared with traditional and less accurate methods, the price of a glass spacer bending machine is economically justifiable.

settings.title: How Does a Spacer Bending Machine Work?
settings.text:
With a spacer bending machine, the operator first places the aluminium spacer for double-glazed glass in the machine's feeding section. The required dimensions are then entered into the machine.
Dimensional data can be entered manually using the touchscreen or transferred to the machine via a USB flash drive. On a USB-enabled spacer bending machine, importing dimensions from an Excel file makes data entry considerably faster.
The dimensions can describe any geometric shape, including squares, rectangles, triangles, circles and polygons. Once the data has been entered, bending and cutting are performed fully automatically.
The semi-automatic spacer bending machine with a digital meter also takes the spacer width into account and performs drilling to allow desiccant to be filled into the double-glazed unit.

settings.title: Introducing the Semi-Automatic Spacer Bending Machine with Digital Meter
settings.text:

settings.title: Key Considerations When Buying a Spacer Bending Machine
settings.text:
One of the most important factors in a double-glazed glass spacer bending machine is the quality of the bend. After bending, the spacer corners must not be wider or narrower than the spacer's width along the other sections.
Otherwise, at that point, the spacer may not bond properly to the glass during butyl application and pressing. This can result in argon gas leaking from between the double-glazed panes.
Therefore, consider the following points when purchasing a machine:
Spacer width range
Depending on the machine design, the width of spacers it can bend may range from 6 to 24 mm, which covers almost all requirements for double-glazed window production.
Frame dimensions supported
The minimum window dimensions for production are usually 100 × 250 mm. If two spacers are used, the maximum window dimensions can reach 2000 × 4000 mm.
Cutting and bending accuracy
Machine accuracy is very high, typically around half a millimetre over medium lengths.
Bending quality
Many glass spacer bending machines on the market do not produce a satisfactory bend and may flatten or even tear the spacer during bending. This can cause the desiccant inside the spacer to leak out, preventing the window from performing properly.
• If you intend to bend the spacer into a circular shape, check the minimum bending radius required. This is typically 200 mm.
• Always request the price of the spacer bending machine from several reputable suppliers. Compare prices and machine capabilities, then choose one that meets your requirements.
